source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Wireless Network Connections' (PDF 17): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Wireless network cables ke baghair devices ko jorta hai. Yeh data bhejne aur receive karne (lene) ke liye radio signals istemal karta hai. Gharon mein Wi-Fi sab se aam wireless technology hai. Network ki range (signal ki pohanch) ke andar devices azadi se move kar (ghoom) sakte hain. Wireless networks install karna (lagana) aur istemal karna aasan hai. Kuch cases (suraton) mein yeh wired networks se slow (aahista) ho sakte hain.

blocks.caption: Wired aur wireless ka muqabla (oopar ke paragraphs se)
rows: Ethernet cables, seedhe router ya switch se
Cables ki wajah se devices aazad nahi
Range ke andar aazadi se ghoom sakte hain

blocks.prompt: Wired connection ka ek faida aur wireless connection ka ek faida batayein.
blocks.explanation: Wired: zyada tez, stable aur mehfooz. Wireless: cables nahi, range mein devices azadi se ghoom sakte hain aur lagana aasan hai.

items: Wireless: radio signals, gharon mein Wi-Fi; range mein azadi; lagana aasan; kabhi wired se aahista.
